brief: Build a homepage for Lena Ortiz, an independent optometrist in Tacoma. Lena sees new patients for routine eye exams and glasses fittings at 42 Example Way, Suite 2. Visitors can call 253-555-0143 between 9 am and 4 pm, Tuesday through Saturday. Make the right person, the two services and the call link easy to find. There is no portrait. Below the introduction, offer a short reminder people can prepare to have ready when they call. Let people choose Eye exam or Glasses fitting, enter a first name and preview their own editable reminder in the browser. No information leaves the page and nothing is booked. Show how to fix a blank name and retain the service choice when the user edits. Avoid photos, insurance claims, reviews, pricing or extra destinations.

Make a homepage for Morgan Reyes, an independent physical therapist in Dayton. Morgan handles post-surgery and running-injury rehabilitation at 25 Example Lane. The office answers 937-555-0127 from 8 am to 3 pm on weekdays. Show who answers, the phone and the hours first. Visitors can prepare a short, editable note for the call. Let them choose Knee rehabilitation or Running assessment, enter a first name and preview. Show a recovery for a missing name. Keep the draft on the page and send nothing. Avoid photos, outcome guarantees and pricing.
